summary: Wisconsin Electric Power Company filed an 8-K on August 24, 2026 to report an ordinary debt offering. On August 19, 2026, it entered into an underwriting agreement to issue $300 million aggregate principal amount of 5.10% Debentures due June 15, 2036, part of the same series as $400 million issued on June 4, 2026. The offering was made under an existing S-3 shelf registration statement. Underwriters are BofA Securities, TD Securities, Wells Fargo, and U.S. Bancorp Investments. No special-situation elements are present; this is a routine shelf takedown of investment-grade debt.
